suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as disease complication. Require documented CKD and independently documented anemia. Do not infer anemia from CKD stage alone, and do not exclude evaluation for other clinically relevant causes of anemia. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Chronic Kidney Disease / Renal Failure and Anemia (Iron Deficiency, Sickle Cell, Aplastic)
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes

Resolution of the publication guard: Require documented CKD and independently documented anemia. Do not infer anemia from CKD stage alone, and do not exclude evaluation for other clinically relevant causes of anemia.
